title: updateSmaxStatusWithoutAd
label: LAZADA · API REFERENCE
subtitle: Enable or pause an SMAX AA campaign without touching its ads. Only campaignId and switchStatus are needed; the switch status also updates the campaign online status. venture/sellerId injected by the gateway.
html:
Request Address

GET/POST/sponsor/solution/smax/updateSmaxStatusWithoutAd
RegionBase URL
Vietnamhttps://api.lazada.vn/rest
Singaporehttps://api.lazada.sg/rest
Philippineshttps://api.lazada.com.ph/rest
Malaysiahttps://api.lazada.com.my/rest
Thailandhttps://api.lazada.co.th/rest
Indonesiahttps://api.lazada.co.id/rest

Request Parameters

Response Parameters
